thread:
Alex W: Quick AM pulse — please drop 1-line on where you are on top deals + any enterprise sec/blocker I should escalate.

Maria L: MacroHealth — legal signed, waiting on SOC2 attestation from customer (told them we can start POC once we get the artifact). No blocker from our side.

Devon R: CortexA — pricing concession request in finance review, sales exec pinged. Tech validation done, just negotiating T&Cs.

Arjun P: NovaGrid — demo next Wed, customer asked for private deployment options + network diagram. Need sec input on what we can share publicly.

Samira (Sec): For NovaGrid: can share sanitized network diagram + standard KMS docs. They asked about HSM — we support KMS integrations; ask them for compliance scope (e.g., PCI/PHI). If they need HSM, we’ll need an enterprise contract addendum.

Maria L: Also FYI — MacroHealth security wants clarification on data retention for logs. I pasted our retention table in the Confluence page: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SEC/pages/retention

Samira (Sec): Thanks — I updated the page with a one-line template they can sign off on. If MacroHealth needs more, we can offer a short SOC2 excerpt. I’ll DM legal to prep.

Devon R: CortexA asked about SSO SAML metadata. Arjun, can you confirm the exact ACS URL we should provide? I think it’s `https://console.redwood.ai/sso/acs` but want to be sure.

Arjun P: Confirmed, ACS = `https://console.redwood.ai/sso/acs`. Also share the IdP metadata URL: `https://console.redwood.ai/sso/metadata`.

Alex W: Great. Who wants escalation to enterprise SEs for NovaGrid HSM question? I can loop ESE if Samira expects a legal addendum.

Samira (Sec): Please loop ESE + legal. I’ll draft a one-paragraph summary of what we can/can't promise in the PO.

Maria L: One small blocker: MacroHealth wants to know if we can enable token-level logging for a dev sandbox for troubleshooting. Is that allowed? @Samira (Sec)

Samira (Sec): We can enable redacted token-level logs in a sandbox with NDA and limited retention. Need to log that in contract. I’ll share the checklist.

Devon R: Ping on a quick CR review — PR #482 (pricing tier bump) awaiting approval. Anyone able to review today? small change in pricing table.

Alex W: I’ll take PR #482 after standup.

jira-bot: Issue RED-247 moved from "Negotiation" to "Contract Review" — assigned to Maria L.

Alex W: Thanks. If nothing else, I’ll escalate NovaGrid HSM to ESE + Legal by noon. Post any objections here.

Maria L: No objections. :thumbsup:

Samira (Sec): go ahead. I’ll add the draft language to the ticket.

Arjun P: I’ll prep the sanitized diagram and drop it in the ticket later this morning.

Alex W: Perfect. End of pulse — if deals shift, update this thread.
